title: C26 arm A: after a held 15m retest, ride to the level (pre-registered)

what.name: Held level
what.value_plain: 15m pivot = highest high (lowest low) of +-16 bars, pulled back >= 0.8%, retested within 0.4% without breaking, pivot <= 72h old; decision 1h after the retest
what.label: OURS

what.name: Entry
what.value_plain: next 15m open toward the level (long under a held high, short over a held low)
what.label: OURS

what.name: Stop
what.value_plain: 0.8% against the entry; a bar touching both = stop
what.label: OURS

what.name: Costs
what.value_plain: 0.10% per round trip (Binance taker x2, backtest/fees.py); slippage and funding not modelled
what.label: SOURCED

how: Rules fixed in C26_PRE_REG.md (commit 21fbba6b) before the run; run once with c26_arms.py.
window: 2022-01-01 to 2026-10-31, split 2022-01..2024-06 vs 2024-07..now (whole history was read: a seen-period check, not a sealed test)

verdict.label: NO: loses about the fee in both periods (net -0.10% / -0.11% per trade, n 1504 / 1362).

why: Price does go back to a held level (C26 magnet), but the distance is short: before fees each trade makes about zero.
The 0.10% taker fee turns that zero into a steady loss; win rate 55% is not enough with a 0.8% stop.
Replay R = net % divided by the 0.8% stop. The ladder shows the stop (bottom line) and the target (top lines).

examples.title: Trade replay (every trade, in time order)
examples.caption: Distance from the entry in %; up is in favour of the trade. No prices.
